title: [Quality Management] Bug 620326: Reset IsChangingStatus on handled Reopen/Finish early-exit
summary: Quality Management's Reopen/Finish procedures now properly reset the IsChangingStatus flag when a subscriber handles the OnBefore events, preventing improper modifications to completed inspections.
key_points: IsChangingStatus flag was stuck true when OnBefore event handlers set IsHandled=true
This caused TestStatusOpen validation to be skipped on later modifications
Flag is now reset before early exit when event is handled
Adds manual subscriber test to verify the fix
Prevents unwanted state changes to finished inspections
quote: Reset the flag before the handled exit.
